name: Mak Fawa
description: A giant mechanical dragon that appeared from beneath the sands and that Mishra learned to control.

timeline.summary: A mechanical dragon rises from the sands and rampages, killing the Qadir; Mishra and Hajar recover the Weakstone and Mishra finds he can control it.
timeline.quote: The Qadir was killed in the confusion.

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The new Qadir makes Mishra his Raki and uses the dragon engine to unify the Fallaji under the Suwwardi.

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Fall of Kroog, Urza's avengers are outclassed by Mishra's dragon engines.
timeline.quote: Urza's avengers were completely outclassed by Mishra's dragon engines

timeline.summary: A mechanical dragon rises and slays the Qadir; Mishra retrieves the Weakstone and discovers he can control the dragon.
timeline.quote: Mishra found he could directly control it instead
